instruction: A candid documentary photograph with a wide shot, eye-level angle, in an indoor motion capture studio with a red carpet and white walls. The man in the dark polo shirt and blue shorts (R1) stands on the left, leaning forward to touch the chest of the woman in the white t-shirt with a red pattern (R2) with his right hand. The woman (R2) stands upright on the right, facing left and looking at him. The scene is illuminated by even overhead lighting.
elements: R1 leans forward and touches R2's chest with his right hand
R2 is the recipient of R1's chest touch, not the person touching R1
R2 stands upright facing and looking at R1 while R1 makes contact
R1 is the active initiator of the touch while R2 remains upright
